verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at twilio.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with Markdown links to pages, and Markdown docs variants such as /docs.md, served with structured schema.org metadata. These are agent-oriented docs an agent can be pointed at directly. Twilio also documents an official MCP server that gives AI coding agents structured access to its public API specifications without authentication. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on corroboration of agents actually consuming llms.txt or the .md docs effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.twilio.com/llms.txt * [Conversational AI and APIs for SMS, Email, Voice](https://www.twilio.com/en-us.md)
gives AI coding agents direct, structured access to Twilio's full API surface—over 1,800 endpoints across 30+ products—without leaving your IDE.
The MCP server indexes public API specifications only. No Twilio account or API keys needed.
